notes.title: The 'Big New Look' Play Test Update
notes.content:
Hi All,

I've just dropped a big update to the Play Test build here on Steam with new features and the brand new look! As part of the games flow, if you're lingering at the bottom of the leader board this is going to impact your progress. Points allow you to not only move up the board, but also progress in a season with elimination points now kicking in at heat 4.

Grab your place today by selecting 'Play Test' from the Super Laser Fury Steam Store page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43688849/20242dc4aa103c72be7924c99dc46f947ac0fe66.png[/img]

Here's some of the highlights in the update:
[list]
[*] New look and feel
[*] New Shop system that has main weapon upgrades
[*] New 'Homing Laser Missiles' that can be upgraded to second rapid shot
[*] New Shop items, Health increase, Stamina boos and Jet Boots upgrades
[*] New Shield item added to Item Drop zones
[*] Updated Slam Dunk function with shield and bigger hit range
[*] Update Arenas - Playing Fields / Crucible
[*] Reordered heats to follow on from each other within the same Arena (1-3 in Playing Fields, 4 - 6 in Crucible)
[*] Music volume control added to settings
[*]Elimination points resulting in season knock outs
[*]Balance of ammo clips based on level of main weapon
[*]Cosmetic tweaks to end heat victory and arena 2 environment changes
[*]Know Issue - Music volume is not being respected when a race begins.
[/list]

I'm still getting around to updating any footage with the new AD but some new screen shots have been popped in. 

As always, keep on running!

notes.title: The 'Fresh Paint' Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

There's not been much news over the last few months and this is because I've been hard at work finishing features(lots to share soon!) but also I want to share in this update a whole new look for the game! 

In much the same way that the game design has taken shape over the years of development - from a third person, narrative based shooter to an arena future sport 'laserthon' - the AD has also been developing in a parallel stream.

This new direction embraces a much more cleaner look and graphic with outlines and colour blocking. I should also reveal that this new look has mainly been driven by the effort and time game assets were taking with the previous hyper real look, balanced with the time this is taking to develop. The environmental effects, screen space reflections, neon glows and lighting are still present as the core of SLF look and identity. As a solo dev I'm looking for smart cut throughs and this new art direction is less time consuming and more forgiving and will help to deliver the final vision to the size I've envisaged, 3 seasons across 18 races and a total of 6 arenas. 

Hopefully this new art direction will add a boost  to the games development and also bring its character to the forefront. So here we are, the new fresh looking Super Laser Fury! 

As always, keep running!
